name: Full cycle · settled OCV, current and fixed cutoff
description: Baseline, parameter check/update and calibration first. For tests, restart charger AC when Ready. Load stays OFF until settled open-circuit voltage passes. Then CV 49 V waits for current to build and settle. With load still ON, CC 5 A immediately tapers by 0.1 A toward 0.5 A to observe cutoff. No charger commands or parameter changes during tests.
